roles.name: surface.primary
roles.description: Main content background - the default page/list surface.

roles.name: surface.chrome
roles.description: Top chrome bar background - Android's app bar / Desktop's title bar.

roles.name: surface.overlay
roles.description: Floating dialog/box/popup background, above the main surface.

roles.name: surface.bubble.in
roles.description: Incoming message bubble background.

roles.name: surface.bubble.out
roles.description: Outgoing message bubble background.

roles.name: text.primary
roles.description: Primary body text on the main surface.

roles.name: text.secondary
roles.description: Secondary/muted text on the main surface (subtitles, captions, icons).

roles.name: text.hint
roles.description: Placeholder/hint text - the dimmest readable text tone.

roles.name: accent.primary
roles.description: The theme's brand accent color - active states, primary actions, links.

roles.name: text.onAccent
roles.description: Foreground color for content drawn on top of an accent-colored surface.

roles.name: border.default
roles.description: Dividers, separators, subtle borders.

roles.name: shadow.default
roles.description: Drop shadows and shadow lines.

roles.name: status.error
roles.description: Error/destructive/red semantic color.

roles.name: status.success
roles.description: Success/positive/green semantic color.

roles.name: overlay.scrim
roles.description: Semi-transparent selection/scrim overlay drawn above content.

roles.name: palette.blue
roles.description: The palette's blue swatch.

roles.name: palette.green
roles.description: The palette's green swatch.

roles.name: palette.red
roles.description: The palette's red swatch.

roles.name: palette.golden
roles.description: The palette's golden/yellow swatch.

roles.name: palette.lightblue
roles.description: The palette's light blue swatch.

roles.name: palette.lightgreen
roles.description: The palette's light green swatch.

roles.name: palette.orange
roles.description: The palette's orange swatch.

roles.name: palette.purple
roles.description: The palette's purple/violet swatch.

roles.name: palette.cyan
roles.description: The palette's cyan swatch.

roles.name: text.title.chrome
roles.description: The title text drawn on the chrome surface (contact name, screen title).

roles.name: icon.chrome
roles.description: Icon tint on the chrome surface - Android pairs this exactly with the title text.

roles.name: text.subtitle.chrome
roles.description: The subtitle under the chrome title (online status, member count).

roles.name: accent.icon
roles.description: Icon color drawn on top of an accent-colored surface (FAB icon, filled button icon).

roles.name: button.flat.text
roles.description: Text-only flat button using the accent color directly as foreground (Cancel/Apply style).

roles.name: badge.unread.bg
roles.description: Unread-count badge background for a not-muted chat.

roles.name: badge.unread.bg.muted
roles.description: Unread-count badge background for a muted chat - documented on both platforms as a distinct, deliberately less prominent tone from the not-muted badge.

roles.name: badge.unread.text
roles.description: Unread-count badge text.

roles.name: status.delivered
roles.description: The message delivery checkmark tint - shared by sent and read states on both platforms.

roles.name: quote.bar
roles.description: The colored vertical bar marking a quoted/reply message.

roles.name: quote.author
roles.description: The quoted message's author name.

roles.name: quote.text
roles.description: The quoted message's preview text.

roles.name: media.title
roles.description: File/audio title text inside a message - documented on Desktop as "media filename text".

roles.name: media.subtitle
roles.description: File/audio performer or metadata text inside a message. Desktop has no documented equivalent of this concept, so it has no Desktop authority and inherits text.secondary.

roles.name: media.loader
roles.description: Download/upload progress ring - documented on Desktop as "radial download animation line".

roles.name: icon.onLoader
roles.description: The icon glyph drawn on top of the loader ring - documented on Desktop as "download arrow icon", a separate key from the ring itself.

roles.name: progress.fill
roles.description: The played/filled portion of an audio or voice seekbar, as distinct from its unplayed track.
